Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
monthly bases as indicted by M1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Yousri Abd Elhaleem, 
tested by eng. Wasfy William Nashed, accepted by 
general director eng. Mohamed El-Lawendy, reviewed by chemist Ahmad Elsyed Ebrahem & 
eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman general director of insurance and quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anaan. head 
sector of Damietta power station & eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa head sector of 
insurance and quality control.
System description
The main components of the water monitors

Safety Precautions
Disconnect the power 
 supply of the oil pumps
Check the main post 
 indicator valve on the main network i,. (close) position
Check the water valves in 
 (close) position
Wear the safety shoes, 
 and the helmet
Tools and Equipment
Wrench set.
Screwdriver set.
Pliers.
Greasing gun.
Work to be carried out
Be sure that the oil tank is filled-up with mineral oil.
Be sure t/hat the electrical panel is correctly connected with 
 the power supply switching on the main switch (380/3/50 Hz).
The monitors must be tested in all their functions, 
 controlling the movements utilizing the hydraulic power pack.
Control the monitor movements in emergency condition operating directly on the 
 monitor hand wheels.
Control the opening / closure movements of the water interception valves 
 either through the hydraulic control or through the manual one.
Be sure that the water butterfly valves are easily movable by their emergency 
 hand wheels.
Operate alternatively the hand wheels (15)and control the horizontal and 
 vertical movements for both monitors.
